review.notes: Structural pass: no code fences anywhere in the OCR Markdown, so no swallowed blocks. Every PDF page's text lines were checked against the OCR Markdown with normalized punctuation/case/LaTeX-equivalence, plus a numeric-multiset pass over the table pages (35-39, all values present in both directions) and a URL check. Physical pages 14 and 34 were rendered at 120-125 dpi and read to verify Algorithm 1 and the Appendix B objectives. Figure-internal labels, axis ticks and legends on pages 2, 5-7, 11-13, 16-18, 20, 22-23 and 31 are shown by the embedded figure images and were left untranscribed by design. The single backslash-underscore sequence (reference URL on physical p.36, content\_cvpr\_2016...) renders identically under CommonMark and was left unchanged. Algorithm 1 (physical p.14) is complete in the OCR including lines 16-18 with Eq. (20)/(21) references.

patches.evidence: Rendered PDF physical p.34 shows the E2E + Pretraining Losses and KASO objective lines as 0.3 L_FM + 0.1 L_real + ...; OCR inserted a space after the decimal point in both display equations (0. 3), which renders with a visible gap. The surrounding prose confirms the weights are 0.3 and 0.1.

Rendered PDF physical p.34 shows 0.1 L_real in both the E2E + Pretraining Losses and KASO objective lines; OCR inserted a space after the decimal point (0. 1). Same appendix-B objectives block as the 0.3 patch.

Rendered PDF physical p.34 shows the third objective label as 'E2E + Pretraining Losses:' with spaces around + and between words; \mathrm drops spaces when rendered, garbling the label. The sibling labels use \text (Decoupled Pretraining) or \mathrm{KASO:}, and Figure 5's caption (OCR line 262) spells the same strategy name 'E2E + Pretraining Losses'.

unresolved.evidence: The repeated '(continued).' captions that head the continuation pages of long Tables 8 and 9 are absent from the OCR, which merged each table into a single HTML block under its main caption. No unique information is lost; restoring the repeats would split the merged tables.
The vertical arXiv stamp (arXiv:2609.05588v1 [cs.RO] 4 Sep 2026) in the page margin is omitted by the OCR, as in other reviewed documents; it is not report body text.
